analisisColision.title: MR Collision Analysis
analisisColision.subtitle: Detects MA components that may interfere with MR
analisisColision.dropAvatarHint: Drag your avatar here to scan Modular Avatar components.
analisisColision.maPreviewTooltip: Enable/disable the preview of MA ShapeChanger and MeshDeleter in Edit Mode
analisisColision.autoScanHint: Scanning is performed automatically when clothing is detected.
analisisColision.noCollisionsHint: No MA components that could interfere.
analisisColision.onRootWarning:
These components (Vertex Filter, Mesh Cutter, Shape Changer) are on the clothing root, but they should be on the GameObject of the mesh they modify.

Move them to the correct mesh so they work without conflicts with MR.
analisisColision.checkboxHint: Checked checkbox = stays active. Uncheck to disable during build.
analisisColision.meshOnRootProblem: Meshes (Renderers) were detected directly on the root GameObject of a clothing item. This is an error by the clothing author - meshes should be on child GameObjects.
analisisColision.meshOnRootConsequence: The auto-generation menu system may confuse these meshes with base avatar meshes, causing them to be turned off incorrectly.
analisisColision.meshOnRootSolution: Move the Renderer component to a child GameObject, or remove the mesh if it is not needed.
analisisColision.blendshapeSyncProblem: BlendshapeSync synchronizes avatar body blendshapes in real time, even outside Play Mode. If it is on the clothing root, it affects the body constantly.
analisisColision.blendshapeSyncSolution: Move the component to the mesh that actually needs synchronization (not the clothing root).
analisisColision.blendshapeSyncTempSolution: Use the buttons to stop/restore synchronization in Edit Mode without moving the component.
analisisColision.reflectionWarning: This functionality uses reflection and may stop working with Modular Avatar updates.
analisisColision.controlNotAvailable: The BlendshapeSync controller is not available. Reflection to MA internal types failed.
analisisColision.stopSyncTooltip: Unregisters from the update loop and clears bindings. The component remains but does not synchronize.
analisisColision.restoreSyncTooltip: Re-registers in the loop and forces rebind. Blendshapes will synchronize again.
analisisColision.stopSyncResult:
Synchronization stopped for {0} component(s).

Body blendshapes will no longer be affected in Edit Mode.

Note: The component still exists, only its effect was disabled.
analisisColision.restoreSyncResult:
Synchronization restored for {0} component(s).

Blendshapes will synchronize again in Edit Mode.
analisisColision.ndmfInfo:
• PROBLEMATIC components: Unchecked by default (will be disabled). Check to keep.
• USER DECISION components: Checked by default (will be kept). Uncheck to disable.
• COMPATIBLE components: Not modified (MR respects them)
• MENU button: Disables/enables Animator, Parameters, MenuInstaller, etc. per clothing item.
analisisColision.ndmfBlendshapeSyncInfo: BlendshapeSync: Disabled in NDMF but still active in Edit Mode. Use 'Stop Synchronization' to prevent effects on the body while editing.
